notes: This record was rewritten from the no-sources state on 2026-08-08, the first time the Department of Financial Institutions hosts answered this network (VPN-up route; the state's whole address range had been transport-dark in both conditions when the record was first written). The department's fee schedule is one table covering every entity type - Business Corporation, Cooperative (Stock or Membership), Limited Liability Company, Limited Liability Partnership, Limited Partnership and Nonstock Corporation - and its three expedited rows run across all six entity columns, so appliesToLlcFormation is true: the $100 next-day row, the $250 in-person counter row and the $500 in-person counter row are all present in the LLC column. The FAQ prices the service at $100.00 for each transaction and says expedited requests are acted on by the close of business the following business day, which is why feeIsPerDocument is true: the fee is charged per charter document or service request, not per batch. chargedIfRejected is not stated anywhere on the pages read. standardProcessing.isPublished is null: neither the fee schedule nor the FAQ states a standard turnaround, and the online filing system was not opened, so no value is invented; needsReview names what would settle it. The fee schedule also confirms the LLC's ordinary formation prices that root states.json carries ($170 paper / $130 online) but those are filing fees, out of this namespace's scope. Wisconsin Statutes chapter 183 and the department's administrative rules were not read (docs.legis.wisconsin.gov remained transport-dark on 2026-08-08, three TCP timeouts with clean DNS), so no statute or rule is quoted in this record.
